nonLinkDispositions.rationale: wtgxx-wisdomtree is a quarantined no-supply record (permitted runtime sources report no positive circulating supply or market cap) that can never carry a live score, so this slice is scored on its own fund-share asset class rather than linked as a dependency edge.
USDB is identified by the official balance sheet but remains outside the active scoring set, so it is not promoted into the active dependency graph.
EREBOR_USD is an issuer-identified FBO bank-deposit account holding frxUSD reserve cash, not a holding of the tracked frxUSD token and therefore not a dependency edge.
